description: Rotate all or selected pages of a PDF by 90, 180 or 270 degrees, right in your browser. Fix sideways scans and mixed-orientation documents, then download the corrected PDF — nothing is ever uploaded.

faq.a: Yes — choose “Selected pages” and type a selection like 1, 3, 5-7. Everything else stays untouched.
faq.q: Can I rotate only some pages?

faq.a: No. Rotation only changes the page orientation flag; text and images keep their original quality.
faq.q: Does rotating change the file quality?

faq.a: No — rotation happens entirely in your browser, so your files never leave your device.
faq.q: Is my PDF uploaded to a server?

howTo: Upload a PDF file.
Choose 90°, 180° or 270° and pick all pages or a custom selection.
Click Rotate PDF and download the corrected file.
name: PDF Rotate

description: Extract specific pages or page ranges from a PDF into a brand-new document. Type ranges like 1-3, 5 or 8-10 and download the trimmed PDF in seconds. Fast, free and fully private — processing happens on your device.

faq.a: Yes — pages are copied in the exact order of your selection, and overlapping ranges are deduplicated.
faq.q: Does it keep the page order I typed?

faq.a: Yes. Pages are copied as-is, so layout, fonts and images are preserved.
faq.q: Will the extracted PDF keep its formatting?

faq.a: Only your device memory limits it — you can extract from documents with hundreds of pages.
faq.q: Is there a page limit?

howTo: Upload a PDF file.
Enter the pages or ranges you want, e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10.
Click Extract pages and download the new PDF.
name: PDF Extract Pages
tagline: Pull selected pages into a new PDF

description: Add a diagonal text watermark such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL across every page of your PDF. Tune the opacity, font size, colour and tiling, then download the stamped document. Everything runs locally — your files stay private.

faq.a: A baked-in watermark is very hard to remove cleanly, so double-check the text and opacity before downloading.
faq.q: Can the watermark be removed later?

faq.a: Around 20–30% is readable but keeps the page content clear; raise it for a bolder stamp.
faq.q: What opacity works best?

faq.a: Yes — the watermark is drawn over the page regardless of whether it contains text or scanned images.
faq.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?

howTo: Upload a PDF file.
Type your watermark text and adjust opacity, size and colour.
Click Add watermark and download the stamped PDF.
name: PDF Watermark
tagline: Stamp diagonal text across every page

description: Number every page of your PDF with clean “Page X of Y” footers in seconds. Choose the position, start number and font size, then download the numbered document. No uploads, no accounts — it all happens in your browser.

faq.a: Yes — set any start number, useful when numbering the continuation of a multi-part document.
faq.q: Can I start numbering from a number other than 1?

faq.a: The new numbers are added alongside them. For a clean result, use a PDF without existing numbering.
faq.q: What if my PDF already has page numbers?

faq.a: This tool uses standard “Page X of Y” numbering; Roman numeral styles are not supported yet.
faq.q: Can I use Roman numerals?

howTo: Upload a PDF file.
Pick a position, a start number and a font size.
Click Add page numbers and download.
name: PDF Page Numbers

description: Read and update a PDF's metadata — title, author, subject and keywords — without installing anything. See exactly what information your document carries, edit it, and download the updated file. Runs entirely on your device.

faq.a: Hidden properties like title, author and keywords that describe the document — visible in readers' document-properties panels.
faq.q: What is PDF metadata?

faq.a: No. Only the document properties change; pages, text and images stay exactly the same.
faq.q: Does editing metadata change the visible content?

faq.a: Never — metadata is read and written locally in your browser.
faq.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?

howTo: Upload a PDF file.
View the current title, author, subject and keywords.
Switch to Edit, change the fields, and download the updated PDF.
name: PDF Metadata Editor
tagline: View and edit title, author & keywords

description: Inspect any PDF instantly: page count, page dimensions, PDF version, file size and encryption status. A read-only report generated locally in your browser — your document is never uploaded anywhere.

faq.a: PDF Info shows technical facts about the file (version, dimensions, encryption); the metadata editor shows editable properties like title and author.
faq.q: How is this different from the metadata editor?

faq.a: Sizes are read directly from the PDF page boxes and matched against standard formats like A4 and Letter.
faq.q: How accurate is the page-size detection?

faq.a: Yes — it detects encryption and still reports the basic details it can read.
faq.q: Does it work on encrypted PDFs?

howTo: Upload a PDF file.
The report appears automatically — pages, sizes, version and encryption.
Nothing is downloaded; the file is never modified.
name: PDF Info

description: Combine multiple JPG or PNG images into a single PDF document in seconds. Pick a page size, fit or fill each photo, and download the result — perfect for scanned documents and photo collections. Everything is processed on your device.

faq.a: Yes — pages follow the order shown in the preview; remove any image before building.
faq.q: Are the images placed in the order I added them?

faq.a: JPG and PNG images are embedded without re-compression; WebP images are converted to PNG first.
faq.q: Do the images lose quality?

faq.a: There is no fixed limit — very large batches are constrained only by your device's memory.
faq.q: How many images can I combine?

howTo: Drop one or more images (JPG, PNG, WebP).
Choose a page size and fit or fill sizing.
Click Create PDF and download.
name: Images to PDF
tagline: Turn JPG & PNG photos into one PDF

description: Turn plain text into a clean, readable PDF document with adjustable font size and margins. Add an optional title, preview the word count, and download — no word processor needed. Works fully offline in your browser.

faq.a: The body uses one clean font; the title is rendered bold automatically. Rich formatting like italics is not supported.
faq.q: Can I add bold or italic formatting?

faq.a: A standard built-in font that every PDF reader supports, so the file opens correctly anywhere.
faq.q: Which font is used?

faq.a: Text flows across as many A4 pages as needed — there is no length limit.
faq.q: What about very long documents?

howTo: Type or paste your text (add an optional title).
Adjust font size and page margins with the sliders.
Click Download PDF.
name: Text to PDF
tagline: Type text, download a styled PDF

description: Pull the text content out of any PDF and copy or download it as a plain .txt file. Page-by-page extraction with line breaks preserved, handled entirely in your browser. Scanned image-only PDFs contain no text to extract.

faq.a: Scanned documents are images, not text — they need OCR first, which this tool does not perform.
faq.q: Why is my PDF's text not extracted?

faq.a: Line breaks and page order are preserved, but columns, tables and exact positioning are flattened into plain text.
faq.q: Is the layout preserved?

faq.a: No — extraction runs with a local PDF engine in your browser; the file never leaves your device.
faq.q: Is my document uploaded?

howTo: Upload a PDF file.
Click Extract text and wait for each page to be read.
Copy the text or download it as a .txt file.
name: PDF to Text
tagline: Extract readable text from any PDF
